About Me

I'm a Data Engineering learner and aspiring Data Engineer with a strong foundation in Python, SQL, databases, and programming.

Through DECI and my current training in the DEPI Data Engineering Track, I've developed practical experience in database design, data organization, problem-solving, and building programming projects.

I help small and medium-sized businesses, startups, and organizations turn scattered or difficult-to-manage data into more organized and usable solutions. My focus is on building reliable database systems, automating data-related tasks, and creating efficient foundations for working with data.

I'm continuously developing my skills in data pipelines, data engineering tools, and cloud technologies while applying what I learn through hands-on projects. I'm open to opportunities in Egypt, the Gulf region, and beyond.

Bookstore Database
